en.title: Campus Appliance Finder
en.text: A mobile-first web app that lets Dalhousie students locate fridges and microwaves across campus with an interactive map and real-time markers. Built with React, TypeScript, and SQLite for local data storage.

es.text: Una app web móvil que permite a estudiantes de Dalhousie localizar refrigeradores y microondas en el campus con un mapa interactivo y marcadores en tiempo real. Construida con React, TypeScript y SQLite para almacenamiento local.

fr.text: Une application web mobile-first permettant aux étudiants de Dalhousie de localiser réfrigérateurs et micro-ondes sur le campus via une carte interactive. Construite avec React, TypeScript et SQLite.

ko.text: Dalhousie 캠퍼스에서 냉장고와 전자레인지를 실시간 마커와 인터랙티브 맵으로 찾을 수 있는 모바일 웹 앱. React, TypeScript, SQLite로 구축.

en.title: Target
en.text: Holistic health tracking app combining sleep, diet, and workouts into one dashboard for personalized insights. Developed with React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. (Still in development.

es.text: App de seguimiento de salud holística que combina sueño, dieta y entrenamientos en un dashboard para insights personalizados. Desarrollada con React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML y CSS.

fr.text: Application de suivi santé holistique intégrant sommeil, alimentation et entraînements pour des insights personnalisés. Développée avec React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML et CSS.

ko.text: 수면, 식단, 운동을 통합한 종합 건강 추적 앱으로 개인화된 인사이트 제공. React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS로 개발.

en.title: NS Move
en.text: Web app (Honorable Mention at RBC HubHacks 2025) solving transportation challenges for underprivileged communities with carpool matching and real-time ridesharing. Built using React and TypeScript.

es.text: App web ganadora de hackathon (Mención Honorable en RBC HubHacks 2025) que resuelve problemas de transporte para comunidades desfavorecidas con coincidencia de carpool y compartición de viajes en tiempo real. Construida con React y TypeScript.

fr.text: Application web primée au hackathon (Honorable Mention RBC HubHacks 2025) résolvant les défis de transport pour communautés défavorisées via covoiturage et partage en temps réel. Avec React et TypeScript.

ko.text: 취약계층 교통 문제를 해결한 해커톤 앱 (RBC HubHacks 2025 Honorable Mention)으로 카풀 매칭과 실시간 공유승차 기능. React와 TypeScript로 구축.

en.title: Automated Content Generation & Publishing System
en.text: An AI-powered content automation pipeline built with n8n that generates, enriches, and automatically publishes content across platforms. Designed to support scalable content marketing and SEO by handling ideation, formatting, and scheduled posting with minimal manual intervention.

es.text: Pipeline de automatización de contenido impulsado por IA construido con n8n, que genera y publica contenido automáticamente en múltiples plataformas. Diseñado para marketing de contenidos y escalabilidad SEO.

fr.text: Pipeline d’automatisation de contenu basé sur l’IA, développé avec n8n, permettant la génération et la publication automatiques de contenu. Conçu pour le marketing de contenu et l’optimisation SEO à grande échelle.

ko.text: n8n으로 구축한 AI 기반 콘텐츠 자동화 파이프라인으로, 콘텐츠 생성·가공·게시를 자동으로 처리하여 콘텐츠 마케팅과 SEO 확장성을 지원.
